 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Lifestyle Lifestyle Bea Millan-Windorski highlights Filipino hospitality with Sampaguita-inspired gown at Miss Universe 2026 
 By GMA News Published November 18, 2026 2:50pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: Seven Barretto via Bea Millan-Windorski/IG Bea Millan-Windorski showcased the best of Filipino hospitality in her Sampaguita-inspired gown at the Miss Universe 2026 pageant.
 On Instagram, the Filipina beauty queen shared photos of herself wearing a yellow gown paired with a sampaguita-inspired neckpiece during a pre-pageant event in Puerto Rico on Tuesday.
 The dress was designed by Filipino fashion designer Jot Losa.
 "To welcome someone with sampaguita is to offer more than a garland. It is to offer a piece of Filipino culture, a symbol of purity, humility, respect, and heartfelt hospitality," she shared.

 "Each delicate white blossom carries a simple yet profound message: you are welcomed with warmth and honored with sincerity," she added.
 Bea is vying for the Philippines' fifth Miss Universe crown after Catriona Gray in 2018.
 The Miss Universe 2026 pageant will take place on November 24 in Puerto Rico.
